statement: Lambda lists on-demand single-GPU B200 SXM6 180GB capacity at $6.99 per GPU-hour.
why: A named provider list price for current-generation Blackwell capacity anchors what a buyer pays without a contract.

impact.mechanism: Static list price with no stated baseline or change; a display overlay rather than a demand or supply signal.

confidence.basis: Vendor list page, secondary for market-wide pricing; single provider only.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 2.79 -> 6.99 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda (lambda.ai) GPU Cloud pricing
